about: The fixed AI-answer panel (SEO master plan §7 'measure AI visibility'). Ask every question, in this wording, on three engines — Google AI Mode (or the AI Overview on the plain search), ChatGPT with search, Perplexity — and record per engine: cited (one of our URLs appears in the sources) and named (Game Day Edition is named in the answer), plus the URLs the engine cited instead. Judge change on a four-run window, never on one run. Protocol and the log: seo/README.md. Cost today: 0 (run by hand, monthly); a paid weekly run is listed in docs/SEO-PLAN-GDE-2026-10.md as a later step.
